newsitem.title: USA: Rockefeller Center officers face suit.
newsitem.headline: Rockefeller Center officers face suit.

text.p: A class action suit was filed against officers and directors of Rockefeller Center Properties, Goldman Sachs and others, the plaintiff's lawyers said on Monday.

The putative class action asserted claims under federal securities laws and for common law fraud and deceit, arising from the defendants' forced buyout of the Rockefeller Center securities, the lawyers said. The law offices of Curtis V. Trinko LLP and Kaufman, Malchman, Kirby & Squire, LLP represent the plaintiff Frank Debora.
Neither Rockefeller Center Properties nor Goldman Sachs were immediately available to comment.

In February 1996, a group consisting of Goldman Sachs & Co, David Rockefeller and others allegedly initiated a materially misleading and fraudulent proxy solicitation and issued misleading press releases, the lawyers said.
These actions allegedly forced Rockefeller Center shareholders to relinquish their ownership interests in the company for the inadequate price of $8 per share, the lawyers said.
